title: Modern 4602D personnel attend Ramsay lecture
plain: Scott Ramsey, a researcher who studies a claimed crash of a craft carrying alien bodies, says that people from today's version of the 4602D, an Air Force intelligence unit that once looked into UFO reports, came to one of his lectures. He tells Michels he saw this himself and that it happened in Denver. If true, a military unit tied to UFO investigation is still quietly paying attention to his work.
